verdict.rationale: ReelMimic ships first-party command-line entry points as npm scripts: `npm run post-video` with platform, schedule and dry-run flags, and `npm run doctor` for setup checks. However, the core make-a-video workflow is driven through the web UI and chat, and there is no documented standalone CLI. missing for 10: a dedicated official CLI binary or command reference, CLI-driven video creation and approval, agent- or scripting-oriented CLI docs (e.g. machine-readable output), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: npm run post-video -- <project id> --platforms tiktok --at 2026-10-05T18:00 --tz Europe/Madrid --send
npm run post-video -- <project id> --platforms tiktok,instagram,youtube # dry run: shows what it would post
You can run the check again any time with `cd app && npm run doctor`.
